_comment: Ratcheted ceilings for check-styled-part-has-setting.py, one section per pass: every gated site keyed file::symbol::stem (attribute keys are sgs/<block>::<attribute>) with its count. A section only shrinks. Lower it with --write-baseline --pass <name> after a migration; never raise it to absorb a new finding.

buttons._comment: Every target and unrecognised button site, keyed file::symbol::stem.

parts._comment: Every BEM part with a literal look and no setting, keyed file::symbol::part.

unmapped._comment: Every look-role attribute the database cannot place (sgs/<block>::<attribute>) and every visitor-visible word no attribute shares a stem with (file::symbol::word).
